name: The Last (Cursed) Boat Home
source:
A mostly-kinetic visual novel about an ostracized teen desperately holding on to a life she knows she couldn't have tried to claim.

She knows how this will end, because she's cursed. 

[From [url=https://nerves-nebula.itch.io/the-last-cursed-boat-home]itch.io[/url]]
